name: JW Marriott Cancun Resort & Spa
positioning: Beachfront resort in Cancun's Hotel Zone with a large Mayan-inspired spa and ocean-view rooms
best_for: Travelers who want a spa-focused beach stay in Cancun
Guests who want a club-level stay with lounge access

facts.text: The resort is a beachfront resort on Blvd. Kukulcan at Km 14.5 in Cancun's Hotel Zone.
Room design reflects the hotel's Mexican roots, with turquoise hues inspired by the Caribbean Sea.
The majority of rooms have balconies and ocean views.
Club 91 rooms include personalized service, premium amenities, Club Lounge access and curated culinary offerings.
The Club 91 lounge offers complimentary culinary presentations with live food stations representing the specialty restaurants.
The Grand Ocean Front Suite has a separate living room and a large private balcony with ocean views.
Besides the beach, there are free-form outdoor pools for families and for adults.
Wellness experiences include sunrise yoga, sound healing baths and mindful activities.
Sens-yah Spa has an indoor lap pool, steam rooms, Jacuzzis and tennis courts.
Gustino Italian Grill serves homemade pastas, pizzas, premium cuts and fine wines.
The JW Lobby Bar has a menu of 50 handcrafted margaritas.

highlights.text: There is a 14-foot-deep dive pool with an artificial reef.
Sens-yah Spa covers 35,000 square feet and offers Mayan-inspired treatments.
Guests can swim in the infinity pool or relax in a beachfront cabana.
The Presidential Suite has expansive indoor and outdoor areas, a private balcony, separate living and dining spaces and Club 91 privileges.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes that common areas can be busy during peak season.
